guarantees.claim: block_addr_limit is assigned the KeccakCountW-cast value of KeccakRate indexed by strength_i when strength_i is L128/L224/L256/L384/L512; otherwise it is assigned zero.

assumptions.claim: KeccakRate array must contain entries for indices L128, L224, L256, L384, L512.
assumptions.risk: out-of-bounds array access may cause X propagation or incorrect block_addr_limit.

uncertain_points.claim: The cast KeccakCountW'(KeccakRate[...]) may truncate if KeccakRate values exceed the bit-width of KeccakCountW, potentially yielding incorrect block_addr_limit.
uncertain_points.cond: when KeccakRate[strength] > maximum value of KeccakCountW type
uncertain_points.risk: block_addr_limit could be wrong, affecting SHA3 padding correctness.
